853:t_27:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I know that name is borrowed. But to me and everyone else, you're nobody but $$トロワ・バートン$$.」

853:t_27:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all... I understand very well how important a name is.」

853:t_28:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Knowing you, Mr. $$カトル$$, I imagine you've always led a blessed life...」

853:t_28:6.en:
$$カトル$$
「But right now I'm away from my family... In their place, though, I have my comrades.」

853:t_28:7.en:
$$カトル$$
「Of course, AG... You're one of them too.」

853:t_28:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you for such generous words. It makes me want to be added to the $$マグアナック隊$$ myself.」

853:t_28:9.en:
$$カトル$$
「In your case, it'd be good to have $$ラシード$$ train your mind.」

853:t_28:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A gentle face with harsh words... Mr. $$カトル$$ is truly no ordinary man...」

853:t_29:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How about a hospitality game of mahjong to celebrate the ace? Right now Mr. $$アルト$$ is the one to go after.」

853:t_29:6.en:
$$五飛$$
「Why mahjong, of all things? And why does $$アルト$$ come into it?」

853:t_29:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm glad you laughed! You're such a $$ナタク$$-serious type, and you're to-$$ナタク$$-lly unresponsive to this kind of thing!」

853:t_29:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... if you were doing it $$ナタク$$-convinced, I wouldn't be voicing so $$ナタク$$-many complaints.」

853:t_29:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... I seem to have gotten carried away...」

853:t_30:4.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「To think that someone like me would be congratulated by anyone.」

853:t_30:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As I said before, putting yourself down like that gets ridiculous once it goes too far.」

853:t_30:6.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「You're right. Let me simply enjoy this.」

853:t_30:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You don't look happy at all! Please express your joy with your whole body!」

853:t_30:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you dance with a huge grin and let out a shriek or so, that should do it perfectly.」

853:t_30:10.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I'm an awkward man. I can't quite work it out, so could you show me an example?」

853:t_30:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ugh... storming a handsome man's stronghold is not easy, it seems...」

853:t_31:4.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Come any closer and I'll shoot!」

853:t_31:6.en:
$$ノイン$$
「It's not 'right off the bat.' I've always told you to stay away from $$ゼクス$$ and me.」

853:t_31:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「H-how cruel... and this is a celebration I went out of my way for...」

853:t_31:8.en:
$$ノイン$$
「I've seen this pattern several times: you appeal to sympathy, then sexually harass someone who lets their guard down.」

853:t_31:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A-as expected of Miss $$ノイン$$...! To think you saw through me that far...!」

853:t_31:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then what am I supposed to do!?」

853:t_31:14.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Snapping back won't change it. No means no.」

853:t_32:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're so honest, Miss $$ヒルデ$$. Naturally, someone like that...」

853:t_32:6.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Oh... if you come near me, I'll shoot.」

853:t_32:8.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「$$ノイン$$ told me. To be on maximum guard around AG, and not to hesitate to use force...」

853:t_32:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I-I never thought there'd be another student here who received Instructor $$ノイン$$'s training...」

853:t_32:10.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「You want to harass someone that badly?」

853:t_32:12.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Saying it with such a big smile doesn't help...」

853:t_32:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm something like the cheerful God of Death you love so much, Miss $$ヒルデ$$.」

853:t_33:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$ガロード$$!」

853:t_33:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Thanks, AG. You... don't seem to be as bad a guy as everyone says.」

853:t_33:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course not! Sincerity is my selling point!」

853:t_33:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm in a great mood today! Come, come... let's invite Miss $$ティファ$$ too and hold a banquet for the ace pilot!」

853:t_33:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Sorry... On second thought, keeping $$ティファ$$ anywhere near you is out.」

853:t_33:9.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm no $$ニュータイプ$$, but all I can see is a lousy ending.」

853:t_33:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ugh... in the end, I'm not trusted...」

853:t_34:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Speaking of Mr. $$ロラン$$, it's the $$ムーンレィス$$... And speaking of the $$ムーンレィス$$, the people of the Moon... So I've prepared the perfect outfit.」

853:t_34:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Speaking of what lives on the Moon, rabbits... And speaking of rabbits, bunny girls. Now, now... please change quickly.」

853:t_34:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What are you saying? Now then... quickly, show me the $$ローラ$$ I've heard so much about.」

853:t_35:4.en:
$$シン$$
「Thanks, AG. But seriously, enough with the 'Mr.' already.」

853:t_35:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... if that's what you wish... But calling a customer by his bare name is something I'd hesitate to do...」

853:t_35:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My, my... 'Shinsan,' as in bitter hardship? What a perfectly fitting name.」

853:t_35:9.en:
$$シン$$
「I don't know why, but I'm suddenly feeling really awful...」

853:t_35:10.en:
$$シン$$
「You... are you looking down on me?」

853:t_35:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all. Even if I were begged, I'd refuse to taste bitter hardship.」

853:t_35:12.en:
$$シン$$
「Forget it! I was an idiot to try to get along with you!」

ラシード.evidence: Rashid Kurama, leader of Quatre's Maganac Corps (Gundam Wing); not in glossary sheet
